Register.title: Register
Register.intro: An admin must approve your account before you can use the system.
Register.doctorHint: Doctors must use their HFSO email.
Register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

Setup.title: Set up this device
Setup.intro: Do this once on every phone, tablet and laptop, before the clinic opens. It lets the browser trust the EMR's secure connection, so there are no warnings.
Setup.notAvailable: No certificate on this computer. Open this page through the hub's address (https://…) to get it.
Setup.iphone: Tap Download, then Allow. Open Settings → Profile Downloaded → Install. Then go to Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings and switch on full trust for “HF EMR Local Authority”.
Setup.android: Tap Download. Open Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate, and pick hf-emr-root.crt. Menu names differ between phones; search Settings for “certificate”.
Setup.computer: Windows: open the downloaded file → Install Certificate → Current User → Place all certificates in → Trusted Root Certification Authorities. Mac: open it in Keychain Access, then set it to Always Trust.

Backups.title: Backups
Backups.intro: Encrypted copies of every record and photo. One is made every night; make one now before anything risky.
Backups.details: {patients, plural, one {# patient} other {# patients}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · {size} MB
Backups.keepSafeUsb: At the end of each clinic day, copy the newest backup (the .hfbak and .json files in the backups folder, or use Download) to a USB stick that leaves with someone other than the hub.
Backups.keepSafeKeys: A backup can only be opened with the BACKUP_KEY and AUDIT_KEY from setup. Keep a copy of both away from the hub, or a lost hub means lost backups.

Audit.title: Audit log
Audit.intro: Every sign-in, record view, change, export and admin action, in order. Entries are chained so edits are detectable.
Audit.verifyIntro: Recomputes every entry. With a checkpoint from a backup or a printout, it also proves the log wasn’t rewritten since then.
Audit.checkpointHint: Leave both empty to check the chain on its own.
Audit.chainOk: The audit log is intact: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} verified.

chainBroken.hash: Entry #{id} was changed after it was written. Entries before it ({count}) are intact.
chainBroken.link: The chain breaks at entry #{id}: an entry before it was removed or changed. Entries before it ({count}) are intact.
chainBroken.checkpoint: The log no longer matches the checkpoint at entry #{id}: it was rewritten or entries were removed since then.

Data.exportIntro: CSV opens in Excel (one row per patient). JSON holds every record and can be imported into another hub. Both contain patient data: keep them on encrypted drives and delete copies when done. Photos are not included.
Data.importIntro: Adds patients and records from a JSON export of this trip. Nothing already here is changed or deleted, and importing the same file twice adds nothing.

Sync.title: Sync
Sync.intro: Bring records from a fallback laptop back into the hub. Nothing on the hub is overwritten: edits made on both sides wait below for you to choose.
Sync.importIntro: Made on the fallback laptop with emr-tool.bat export-bundle. Importing the same bundle again adds nothing.
Sync.summaryPatients: {count, plural, =0 {add no new patients} one {add # new patient} other {add # new patients}}
Sync.summaryRecords: add {count} records, apply {applied} edits made only on the laptop ({here} already here)
Sync.summaryAudit: {count, plural, one {append # audit entry} other {append # audit entries}} from the laptop
Sync.summaryConflicts: {count, plural, one {# record was} other {# records were}} edited on both sides: see the queue below.
Sync.summaryNumbers: New hub numbers (the laptop numbers stay on the record and are searchable):

Sync.howProvision: Before the trip, on the hub, then on each fallback:
Sync.howExport: When the hub is back, on the fallback:
Sync.howNotes: Each fallback needs its own NODE_ID and the hub’s SYNC_KEY. Fallbacks start with accounts and trips only, not existing patients; accounts changed on a fallback aren’t copied back.
Sync.conflictIntro: Edited on the hub and on {node} (found {time}). The hub’s copy is kept unless you choose the laptop’s.
Sync.nowSame: The hub already matches the laptop’s version for every field. Saving closes the conflict.
